verdict.rationale: GitHub publishes an official GitHub MCP server (github/github-mcp-server). First-party docs explain using it to interact with repositories, issues, pull requests and other GitHub features, and say it can be configured remotely or locally. missing for 10: evidence of connecting third-party (non-Copilot) agents, since the docs are framed around Copilot Chat in the IDE; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Learn how to use the GitHub Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to interact with repositories, issues, pull requests, and other GitHub features, directly from Copilot Chat in your IDE.
The GitHub MCP server in Visual Studio Code can be configured remotely or locally.
